'''Tyno Fabris''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Arkanian/Legends|Arkanian]] who served as a [[Lieutenant/Legends|lieutenant]] of the [[Black Sun/Legends|Black Sun]] [[Vigo/Legends|vigo]] [[Prince/Legends|Prince]] [[Xizor/Legends|Xizor]] during the early [[Standard year/Legends|years]] of the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]]. Fabris maintained an office within the ''[[Oyu'baat]]'' [[Tapcafe/Legends|tapcafe]] in the [[City/Legends|city]] [[Keldabe/Legends|Keldabe]], on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Mandalore/Legends|Mandalore]]. In about [[18 BBY/Legends|18 BBY]], the [[Jedi Knight/Legends|Jedi Knight]] [[Jax Pavan]] met with Fabris and attempted to negotiate with Fabris to obtain details regarding the location of [[Thi Xon Yimmon]]&mdash;the captured leader of the Whiplash resistance group&mdash;in return for [[pyronium]].
